Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: User workspace organization and BYO Slack App webhook configuration.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the workspace owner.

operatorRole.description: Default operator role for role-gated actions.

webhookUrl.description: Generated EdgeOps Slack Events webhook URL for this workspace.

slackBotToken.description: Optional BYO Slack Bot OAuth token.

slackConnected.description: Whether the user completed BYO Slack app credentials.

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description: An operational alert or customer support ticket triaged locally via on-device Gemini Nano and optionally investigated in the cloud.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

title.description: Short headline describing the alert or ticket.

channel.description: Source Slack or alert channel tag (e.g. #ops-alerts).

industryPack.description: Industry pack context associated with this incident.

status.description: Current workflow state; RESOLVED is terminal.

noiseSuppressed.description: True when local triage classified the alert as suppressed noise.

rawMessage.description: Original unredacted alert text kept owner-private for local Privacy Shield diff.

scrubbedMessage.description: Locally redacted text with PII replaced by protected placeholders.

redactionCount.description: Number of PII entities locally redacted before cloud calls.

inferenceSource.description: Model execution source for the latest analysis.

diagnosis.description: Plain-English What Happened diagnosis from Cloud Investigation.

toolsUsed.description: List of tool names retrieved and executed during Cloud Investigation.

totalToolsAvailable.description: Total number of pluggable tools available in the registry during retrieval.

investigatedRole.description: Role under which Cloud Investigation was executed.

approvedReply.description: Final approved reply dispatched to Slack.

slackPosted.description: Whether the reply was posted to a configured BYO Slack webhook.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Connector.title: Connector
Connector.description: A user-registered vendor-agnostic MCP Server URL or imported OpenAPI JSON spec.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

endpointUrl.description: Base URL or MCP server endpoint.

toolCount.description: Count of tools exposed by this connector.

enabled.description: Whether this connector is active for dynamic tool retrieval.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user workspace settings including linked org, onboarding status, active pack, role, and BYO Slack webhook.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

orgName.description: Display name of the linked workspace.

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether first-run onboarding has been completed or skipped.

activeRole.description: Selected operational role for role-gated actions.

slackWebhookUrl.description: Optional BYO Slack App incoming webhook URL.

/orgs/{orgId}.description: User-created workspace organizations and BYO Slack app configurations.

/incidents/{incidentId}.description: Real-time user-scoped operational incidents and alerts feed.

/connectors/{connectorId}.description: User-scoped custom MCP Server URLs and imported OpenAPI tool connectors.

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace link, onboarding flag, industry pack, role, and BYO Slack webhook configuration.
